headlines.title: Internet down: Google Cloud outage leaves websites including Lloyds Bank, Rightmove and DPD not working
headlines.summary: Technical problem is the latest example of invisible internet infrastructure taking down seemingly unconnected websites and apps

headlines.title: What is Google Cloud and why is it important?
headlines.summary: Google Cloud is part of the hidden plumbing of the internet.

headlines.title: Anthropic is giving away 5% of the company. Why is everyone mad?
headlines.summary: Anthropic just pledged 5% of its company to the public, which amounts to roughly $100B at its rumored $2T IPO valuation. Host Ejaaz Ahamadeen breaks down how the philanthropic pledge differs from universal basic income, the industry’s backlash, and what Anthropic’s move could signal about AI’s impact on the workforce.

headlines.title: AI Stocks: SpaceX 2027 Data Center Expansion Could Be Game Changer
headlines.summary: AI stocks face an earnings test, with SpaceX and Meta due, as investors question massive spending and look for return on investments.

headlines.title: Anthropic sets aside 5% stake for public benefit fund ahead of November IPO
headlines.summary: Before a single public share trades, Anthropic is already giving a slice of itself away, and the structure means the better the stock performs, the more new shareholders lose to the fund.

description: Alphabet Inc. offers various products and platforms in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia-Pacific, Canada, and Latin America. It operates through Google Services, Google Cloud, and Other Bets segments. The Google Services segment provides products and services, including ads, Android, Chrome, devices, Gmail, Google Drive, Google Maps, Google Photos, Google Play, Search, and YouTube. It is also involved in the sale of apps and in-app purchases and digital content in Google Play and YouTube; and devices, as well as the provision of YouTube consumer subscription services, such as YouTube TV, YouTube Music and Premium, NFL Sunday Ticket, and Google One. The Google Cloud segment offers consumption-based fees and subscriptions for AI solutions, including AI infrastructure, Vertex AI platform, and Gemini enterprise. It also provides cybersecurity, and data and analytics services; Google Workspace that include cloud-based communication and collaboration tools for enterprises, such as Calendar, Gmail, Docs, Drive, and Meet; and other enterprise services. The Other Bets segment sells transportation and internet services. Alphabet Inc. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Mountain View, California.
